flyer.justification: The flyer adheres strictly to all format constraints including the word count limit on the title and proper TBA placeholders.

linkedin.justification: Well-crafted LinkedIn post with strong insights, no banned buzzwords/clichés, and an engaging thought experiment call to action.

summary.justification: Adheres well to executive briefing formatting under 400 words, though it introduces Daniel Kahneman who was not named in the reference transcript.

instagram.justification: Meets all requirements including carousel slide cues, emoji usage, short lines, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter is well structured with three bold subheadings and editorial tone, but the subject line exceeds the 50-character limit.

blog.justification: Excellent long-form blog post adhering to all structural requirements including numbered sections, Markdown table, and About the Author section.
